title: How to upgrade the character generator with dlc?

posts.author: WhereAmI74
posts.body:
I'm not familiar with RPG Maker tool.
I bought all the all generator DLC as much as I could on Steam this black friday sale.
(I have all Heroine Generator.)
when I'm going to apply this before,
open the DLC folder, there are a lot of generator parts
there is same name parts so it makes conflict.
and I found that it takes too much time to rename parts one by one.
How are people currently buying and applying the generator DLC parts?
The computer can't tell whether it's a hat or clothes even by looking at the part image,
so I think it should be done with the human eye.
That think frightens me.
----
People say to me use 'game character hub'
but somehow i can't update new generator,
this app can't not detected my dlc
then restart
?
Same..

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
WhereAmI74 said:
and I found that it takes too much time to rename parts one by one.
Click to expand...
It's what you need to do. One would hope that paid DLC files would come with correct names and all you potentially need to do is change the numbers. But I don't know of a way to do that automatically.
WhereAmI74 said:
People say to me use 'game character hub'
Click to expand...
I haven't used it, but I don't see anything in the description of that program that says it can use generator parts formatted differently than the default generator expects.
